quote: mean reach distances for the anterior (F = 3.818, p = 0.025)
reason: Both shipped and blind extract the same repeated-measures ANOVA F-statistic (3.818) for the anterior reach direction. For es_type_o = 'test statistic', shipped formats the value as 'F(3, 57) = 3.818', incorporating the nominal repeated-measures ANOVA degrees of freedom (df1 = 4 - 1 = 3, df2 = (20 - 1) * (4 - 1) = 57) derived from the N = 20 participants (p. 5, line 83) and 4 time points (final pre-fatigue and 0, 10, and 20 min post-fatigue; p. 7, lines 143-145), whereas blind records only the bare number '3.818' in value (and 'F = 3.818' in test_statistic) because degrees of freedom are omitted in the Results text.
